sections.excerpt:

sections.excerpt:
Dilution If you purchase our common stock in this offering, your ownership interest will be immediately diluted to the extent of the difference between the initial public
offering price per share of our common stock and the pro forma as adjusted net tangible book value per share of our common stock after this offering and concurrent private placement. sections.excerpt:
